t: You're looking at Marlborough House, a Grade I listed mansion on The Mall, right beside St James's Palace. Today it is the headquarters of the Commonwealth of Nations. Christopher Wren designed it, and Sarah Churchill, Duchess of Marlborough, commissioned it, gave it her name, and died here. Later royals lived in it. Queen Alexandra lived here, and the future George V and his sister Maud, later Queen of Norway, were both born here. Mary of Teck, George V's queen, died in the house in 1953.
